proposeImport.effect: Validates a workspace, optionally with a schema, and opens the visible proposal without changing current state.

proposeSchemaUpdate.effect: Validates one schema-bearing document and opens a visible schema-only proposal that preserves matching workspace state.

applyImportProposal.effect: Applies only the current fingerprint-matched proposal through the normal merge path. A schema-only proposal requires all three booleans to be false.

discardImportProposal.effect: Closes and discards the current proposal without changing current state.

workspaceImport: Wait for the filechooser before activating Load workspace.
If a workspace is already open, review and continue through the replacement warning.
Set one combined workspace, one schema plus one workspace, or one workspace-only absolute path.
Inspect the proposal and choose configuration/layout/pins.
Apply the proposal or leave it open for human review.
schemaUpdate: Activate Update schema and set one schema-bearing file.
Confirm that the proposal mode is schema and inspect added, matching, and removed table counts.
Apply with configuration/layout/pins all false; matching workspace settings, positions, and pins are preserved.
agentImport: Read one combined workspace JSON string and optionally one workspace-only JSON string with a terminal/filesystem tool.
Inspect the returned summary and the visible proposal.
When authorized, call applyImportProposal with the exact returned fingerprint and three explicit boolean choices; otherwise leave it open or discard it.
createView: Choose table IDs only from the current schema and add a stable custom entry to workspace.views.
Call proposeImport([updatedWorkspaceJson]) and inspect the visible proposal.
Apply with configuration=true, layout=false, pins=false so existing physical placement is retained.
export: Pause the simulation using the real button when exact current positions are required.
Write the returned string with a filesystem tool using private permissions; clipboard and browser downloads are not required.
humanLoop: Leave the graph open for manual placement and pins.
After the user says they are done, re-read status, fingerprint, revision, and dirty state.
Pause the simulation, read getWorkspaceJson(), store it, then propose and apply it again to verify an exact round trip.
